audience: e-commerce teams that monitor competitor prices with Price2Spy

useCases.title: Find products that competitors sell for less
useCases.text: List the tracked products with their target price and lowest competitor price. Then open the current prices of each product and see which shop is cheaper.

useCases.title: Review the price history of one competitor URL
useCases.text: Find the monitored URL of a SKU, then read its price history with stock status, shipping cost and promotion for each measurement.

useCases.title: Check which monitored URLs failed their last check
useCases.text: List the monitored URLs with the shop, the last check time and the last error. Use the list to fix or remove broken product page links.

useCases.title: Filter products by brand, category or supplier
useCases.text: List the brands, categories and suppliers of the account. Then use the names as filters to list the products of one group.
